subject: Offer authorization request — Ethan Zhao (Sr. Serving Engineer)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-05T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Offer authorization request — Ethan Zhao (Sr. Serving Engineer)

Hi team,

We completed loop interviews with Ethan Zhao (application: Sr. Serving Engineer, Serving Runtime). He's our top pick — strong latency/throughput system background and previous production inference experience at ScaleAI. Candidate scorecards are attached.

Recruit ask: approval to extend an offer with the following terms (proposed):
- Base: $180,000–$195,000 (target $187,500)
- Sign-on: $25,000 (one-time)
- Equity: 0.25% over 4 years (standard cliff)
- Level: IC3 / position titled Sr. Serving Engineer (hiring manager recommends IC3)

Attachments: comp-grid-2026.pdf, ethan_zhao_resume.pdf, offer-draft-ethan.docx

Quick ask: Aditya — can you +1 leveling and manager sign-off? Lauren — would you greenlight the band and confirm no comp exception required, or if an exception is needed what approvals we should route?

Timeline: candidate is accepting verbal offers this week; want to send verbal by Friday if approvals are in place.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0133
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-05T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer authorization request — Ethan Zhao (Sr. Serving Engineer)

Marissa — thanks for the summary. Quick questions before I sign off:
1) Leveling: I want to confirm IC3 vs IC4 discussion. During interviews Ethan presented strong infra-driven ownership but his org size at previous role was small (individual contributor on a 4-person infra team). Hiring panel recommended IC3, but he pushed back on ownership scope. I'm inclined to keep at IC3 but willing to consider IC4 if Lauren approves and comp budget allows.
2) Comp: $180–195k looks fine relative to our band midpoint, but the sign-on/equity pushes total OTE higher. If we need to offer at top of band, I want a justification note we can include in the packet (candidate market comp + immediate impact plan).

If Lauren is comfortable with the exception path (if needed), I can sign off and coordinate manager endorsement language for the offer.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao | Principal, Serving Runtime
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-05T12:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer authorization request — Ethan Zhao (Sr. Serving Engineer)

Thanks Aditya — adding a short justification here and re-attaching the resume.

Candidate rationale for top-of-band:
- Comparable roles in SF market currently showing base medians of $185–205k for serving/runtime engineers with production LLM inference experience.
- Ethan led a latency optimization that reduced p50 by 22% on a heavy-attention model in his last role; that maps directly to our performance goals.
- Immediate availability: can start in 3 weeks (helps close gap on pipeline).

Proposed fallback if Lauren requires an exception: offer base $187.5k (middle of range) + $25k sign-on, revisit equity at 6-month performance check. That keeps us inside band while being competitive.

Attachments: ethan_zhao_resume.pdf (again), comp-grid-2026.pdf

Let me know if Aditya wants to see a short manager impact plan I drafted to justify IC4.

Marissa
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-06T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer authorization request — Ethan Zhao (Sr. Serving Engineer)

Team — reviewed comp-grid and candidate packet. Summary of comp team decision:
- Banding: Candidate maps to Band 3 (IC3) based on scope, deliverables, and previous org size.
- Compensation: Approved range for hire: Base up to $195,000 without exec/comp committee escalation.
- Sign-on: up to $30,000 approved under recruiter discretion for critical hires in serving/runtime.
- Equity: 0.25% within standard grant guidelines approved.

If the team wishes to push base above $195k or increase equity materially, we will need a comp-exception request routed to Compensation Committee (sla ~48 hrs). For now, the proposed package (Base $187.5k target + $25k sign-on + 0.25% equity) is APPROVED.

Conditions:
- Offer letter should include a 6-month performance checkpoint tied to equity vesting acceleration clause (standard language included in offer-draft-ethan.docx).
- Manager (Aditya) to provide 2–3 prioritized OKRs for the first 6 months to include in the packet for candidate clarity.

Lauren Bishop | Sr. Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-06T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer authorization request — Ethan Zhao (Sr. Serving Engineer)

Thanks Lauren — that's great. Aditya, I endorse the IC3 leveling and the approved compensation package. I also confirm the 6-month OKRs:
- Reduce p50 inference latency for our 8B models by 15% in the first 4 months (owner: Ethan)
- Implement prefix/KV caching for two high-traffic endpoints (owner: Ethan)

Please expedite — candidate indicated other active conversations and we risk losing him if we wait past Friday for verbal. Happy to jump on a quick call to finalize wording.

Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-07T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Final: authorization confirmed — proceed to verbal + formal

All — thanks for the fast turnaround. Per Lauren's approval and Jonas' endorsement, we have a green light to extend the verbal offer today with the agreed package:
- Base: $187,500
- Sign-on: $25,000
- Equity: 0.25% (4y, 1y cliff)
- Level: IC3 (Sr. Serving Engineer)

Next steps (recruiter owner):
1) Aditya to send 2–3 prioritized OKRs (by EOD) for inclusion.
2) I will supply the verbal today and send the formal offer (offer-draft-ethan.docx attached) once Aditya's OKRs are in the packet.
3) Lauren will initiate the formal comp record and route to payroll/stock ops.

Attachments: offer-draft-ethan.docx

Marissa
